Side B Boarding Pass

First Time Here?

Welcome aboard! Here’s everything you need to jump into chat like you’ve been here for years.

01

House rules

  • Grab yourself a drink and a snack!
  • No sexist, racist, or homophobic remarks
  • No political, religion or gender debates
  • Respect all members of the community
  • Please don’t spam!
  • Please no self promotion or asking for shoutouts!
  • Pay attention to the vibe and try to chat!
  • Please avoid revealing your age and full name!
  • Be kind to others!

02

Chat commands

Type these in Twitch chat.

!socials
Check out my socials
!discord
Get the Discord invite
!lurk
Let us know you’re lurking
!followers
Shows how many people follow Dismeigh
!followage
Shows how long you’ve been following Dismeigh
!level
Shows what level you are
!watchtime
Shows how long you’ve been watching
!giveaway
Join the giveaway, when one is running

03

When I’m live

The schedule on the home page updates every week, and the site shows when I’m on air. Add it to your calendar so you never miss a session.

See the schedule Add to calendar

04

Between streams

  • Join the Discord and say hey.
  • Check the bounty board for challenges on stream.
  • Set a high score in Bounty Run or Launch Control.
  • Catch up on clips, or meet the crew.

See you next session.

The crew’s asleep. Keep it down.
